senses.gloss: (I)--a sage of the VIIIth manvantara, a sage of सावर्णि epoch; a भार्गव gotrakara and a pravara sage. भा. VIII. १३. १५. Br. III. ६६-72; IV. 1. १०. M. 9. ३२; १९५. २२; १९६. ३१. Vi. III. 2. १७. [page१-533+ २४]
(II)--a sage who came to see कृष्ण at Syaman- तपञ्चक. भा. X. ८४. 4.

(IV)--a कौशिक;
1: वा. १००. १०.
a son of विश्वामित्र, whose wife took him on her neck (gale baddha) to sell him for १०० cows. Satyavrata (Satyavrata त्रिशन्कु-ब्र्। प्।) releas- ed him and undertook to feed both of them so as to earn the gratitude and grace of विश्वामित्र.
2: Br. III. ६३. ८९; वा. ८८. ९०.
